concerns.text: Task T012 implements Welch's PSD with '2-second windows' and 'OVERLAP=0.5'. This contradicts FR-003 and User Story 1 which explicitly mandate '4-second windows'. While the Constitution (Principle VI) specifies 2s windows, the tasks document cannot silently override the spec's explicit requirement without a formal amendment or explicit 'Plan-Override' tag in the task description itself. This is a semantic weakening of the FR-003 constraint.

Task T022a restricts the permutation test to 'shuffle median_rt only on the held-out test set'. FR-007 requires assessing the significance of the 'regression model's R² value'. Standard permutation testing for model significance requires shuffling labels across the entire dataset (or training set) to establish a null distribution for the model's performance metric. Restricting shuffling to the test set (which is small) invalidates the statistical inference required by FR-007 and Constitution Principle VII, effectively weakening the validation requirement.

Task T024 describes comparing adjusted R² via an F-test but fails to explicitly mandate the automatic evaluation of the p-value against the 0.05 threshold and the flagging of the result in the output. FR-012 requires the system to 'report if the non-linear model explains significantly more variance... (p < 0.05)'. The task description leaves this logic open to manual interpretation or omission, risking a failure to satisfy the acceptance criterion of FR-012.

Task T025 bundles robustness and sensitivity analysis but only specifies generating a 'sensitivity_plot.png'. FR-009 explicitly requires generating a 'sensitivity analysis report' that records the 'count of significant correlations at each step' (0.01 to 0.10). Relying solely on a plot violates the requirement for a tabulated/measurable report, failing to satisfy the acceptance criteria of FR-009 and SC-004.
